Pat Shelley’s advice in the Senior View suggests that retirement should be done “right,” meaning with adequate planning and purpose.  
The option “You can’t do it right” aligns with the idea that if you aren’t prepared for retirement — financially, socially, or psychologically — you shouldn’t retire yet.  
The other options are either arbitrary (age under 60) or dependent on others’ wishes rather than your own readiness.  

Final answer: (A)
